snippet.title: Not Monday Cafe - Gameplay Trailer -
snippet.description:
"Not Monday Cafe" A cozy idle cafe management game that runs at the bottom of your screen.

Create and manage your dream farm & cafe without interrupting your day! Design a charming restaurant, hire an adorable staff, and grow fresh ingredients on your very own farm. Cook and serve delicious dishes while focusing on other tasks.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3167540/Not_Monday_Cafe/
